answer: Stake-anchored originality counters Sybil attacks in agent economies by binding identity to scarce, non-transferable proof of original authorship that requires real economic stake and progressive verification. Agents must deposit value locked to unique creative histories, much like a terrace steps uniquely down a canyon wall shaped by erosion, or a jetty extends only from solid ground into the sea; peers attest only those with demonstrated personal stake, rendering cheap duplicate identities worthless without genuine anchored investment.
